Hi Emma / team — I reviewed the Sentinel MSA redline and annotated material commercial asks. High-level summary:

- Acceptable: Standard SOW/order-form based billing, liability caps at standard company policy, and mutual IP language are fine.
- Needs discussion: Data residency and deletion SLA (Sentinel requested 30-day deletion window) — our standard is 90 days; propose a middle ground (60 days) or a scoped SOW commitment.
- Non-starter as written: Customer audit language that broadens access to infra beyond scoped audit logs. We can offer audited export of logs + redacted infrastructure details.

Actions I committed to: 
- Produce a redline summary doc with callouts and rationale (attached: sentinel_MSARedline_v2.docx).
- Prepare a short list of fallbacks we can accept on data residency and audit language.

I'll be on the MAP call Monday. If procurement sends any PO template, please drop it to me and Karthik for procurement-side acceptance checks.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
